review_notes: Read the whole file. Checked the near-duplicate pairs (Min/Max comp_continuousOn, mono_anti/anti_mono') and compared with the sibling file OrderClosedExtr.lean and the duality API in Order/Filter/Extr.lean. The Min/Max comp_continuousOn and bicomp blocks are thin wrappers around existing API, so I did not report them. I did not compile the proposed replacement. It relies on IsLocalMin f b being definitionally IsMaxFilter (toDual ∘ f) (𝓝 b) b, the same unfolding that IsLocalMaxOn.not_nhds_le_map already uses with βᵒᵈ in this file. Elaboration of the explicit (β := βᵒᵈ) application is the remaining uncertainty.

findings.problem: isLocalMin_of_anti_mono' repeats, line for line, the proof of isLocalMax_of_mono_anti' (lines 566-568). Both prove b ∈ a and b ∈ c, take the neighbourhood from nhds_of_Ici_Iic, and split on le_total x b with aesop. The two statements are order duals: swapping Preorder β for βᵒᵈ turns MonotoneOn into AntitoneOn and IsLocalMax into IsLocalMin. The duplicated reasoning is the actual argument, not routine unfolding. A later fix to one copy, such as replacing the aesop call, would have to be made twice. The sibling file already proves the dual lemma by a one-line application at βᵒᵈ.
findings.proposed_change: Keep isLocalMax_of_mono_anti' as the only proof. Replace the body of isLocalMin_of_anti_mono' (lines 575-577) with the dual application, as in the sibling file: `isLocalMax_of_mono_anti' (β := βᵒᵈ) ha hc h₀ h₁`. This should typecheck because AntitoneOn f a is MonotoneOn (toDual ∘ f) a and IsLocalMin f b is IsMaxFilter (toDual ∘ f) (𝓝 b) b by definitional unfolding. The proof sketch of the shared argument is: a ∈ 𝓝[≤] b and c ∈ 𝓝[≥] b give a ∩ c-style membership of b, then nhds_of_Ici_Iic gives a ∪ c ∈ 𝓝 b, and on each side le_total x b picks the monotone or the antitone hypothesis. If the defeq does not unify, use `h.dual`/`undual` from Order/Filter/Extr.lean, or state `IsMaxFilter (toDual ∘ f) ..` explicitly via `isMaxFilter_dual_iff`.
findings.benefit: The case-split argument then lives in one place, and the dual lemma's statement shows it is just the order dual. The file also becomes consistent with OrderClosedExtr.lean and with IsLocalMaxOn.not_nhds_le_map, which already use the βᵒᵈ trick.
